methods.cad:
Independent B-rep checks of the fable Gridfinity fix1 exports (re-review 2026-11-16).
Method: OCP BRepAlgoAPI_Common on the exported STEP solids placed at the assembly.json
transforms (translation only; all rotations are zero). Read-only on the run directory.
methods.mesh:
Independent mesh checks of the fable Gridfinity fix1 exports (re-review 2026-11-16).
trimesh ray casts on the exported binary STLs placed at the assembly.json translations.
Ink maps: rays along the claimed label-face normal classify each 0.1 mm face sample as face
(hit at the face plane) or ink (hit 0.6 mm deeper). Sightlines: rays from the viewer toward
face-plane points at sampled ink locations; a sample is hidden when the first hit lies more than
0.5 mm in front of the target (2 mm column kept for the original review's threshold).
notes: Model scripts were not executed; nothing written in either run directory.
Sightline targets are face-plane points at 72 ink pixels per text line (12 lowest + 60 random), found independently by ink-mapping each label face at 0.1 mm.
Elevations 0/15/20/25/30/35/45/60/75/85/90 deg at azimuth 0 and +/-20 deg; occluders are all 11 placed parts.
Capacity heap volumes are Fermi estimates (ISO 4762 nominal solid volume / assumed loose packing); not measured hardware.

original_method_replay.method: reviews/fable_label_visibility.py logic: bin alone, nominal line centres from assembly.json, lead >2 mm = hidden

finding_1_labels.stacked_note: Lower bin labels (M3x6/8/10) hidden at every view while a bin sits on it; other lines unchanged straight ahead; at 20 deg off-axis the neighbouring columns need up to 60 deg.

stacking.note: Stacked bins are located by the lip chamfer: 0 mm3 at the seat, 22.9 mm3 at 0.05 mm lower, 34.6 mm3 if shifted 0.2 mm sideways without lifting.

capacity.method: downward rays on a 0.25 mm grid over the compartment from its front boundary to the top edge of its label wedge; volume = sum(max(0, zlimit - surface)). Bulk need = solid item volume (ISO 4762/4032/7089 nominal) / loose packing fraction {"screw": 0.3, "nut": 0.45, "washer": 0.25}

finger_probe_heightfield.method: vertical cylinder with hemispherical tip lowered over the downward-ray heightfield (0.25 mm); axis positions on a 0.5 mm grid

finger_probe_cad_note: CAD spot positions were chosen before the heightfield; centre/side positions overlap walls or the lip because the flat floor is shorter than the probe. The heightfield search is the result of record.

notes: 0 mm2 of down-facing surface steeper than 45 deg between z 6.1 and 25 mm: solid wedges and scoops need no support.
36.6 mm2 horizontal down-facing at z 4.75: the 0.5 mm gap between the two feet (standard 1x2 Gridfinity bridge).
Sub-0.8 mm samples: 0.61 mm lip top flat at z 32, 0.27 mm plate edge knife at z 5.9, 0.07-0.19 mm slivers inside letter grooves (0.1 mm2).

claims_checked.floors 18.8 / 28.5 / 22.5 mm: consistent: flat floor at centreline 11.25-12.75 / 20.0 / 15.25 mm plus 7-8 mm scoop
claims_checked.16 mm fingertip reaches every floor: confirmed by heightfield: axis span 1.0-10.5 mm at x=0
claims_checked.20 M4x20 about 8 cm3 as a loose heap, fi: contradicted: 8.1 cm3 is solid metal; a loose heap is 13.5-27 cm3 (packing 0.6-0.3) against 14.6 cm3 below the wedge top
claims_checked.checks_mesh criterion string: states 30/40 deg while the reported results are 25/35 deg (stale text)
